text.p: These are the main stories in Latvian newspapers on Thursday. Prepared for Reuters by the Co-operation Fund. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The Chairman of Latvia's Way, Foreign Minister Valdis Birkavs, said that the government has collapsed and that the prime minisiter's plan will not reslove the crisis.
- Th chairman of NATO's military committee, general Klauss Neumann, arrived on a two-day official visit in Latvia.
- German foreign minister Klauss Kinkel is ready to make a working visit to meet the foreign ministers of Latvia, Estonia and Lithuania in October.
- The agreement on visa-free travel between Latvia and Finland will be signed during the working visit of Finnish Foreign Minister Tarya Karin Halonen on July 28.
- Acting Interior Minister Juris Kaksitis issued an order suspending Riga police chief Igors Kupcis.
- Ukrainian foreign minister Gennady Udovenko arrived on a official visit to Latvia to sign an agreement on mutual promotion and protection of investments.
- President Guntis Ulmanis met with prime minister Andris Shkele and expressed support for his plan to reslove the current political crisis.
- The council of Latvian Shipping company will affirm its 1996 audited results on July 25.
